propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes requires jira_key-bearing local_state but its only caller passes fetched snapshots which lack jira_key fields
Prior art (Unito, Kubernetes reconcilers) explicitly rejects resurrecting hard-deleted work items, contradicting c244's same-pass re-create behavior

A confirmed-404 binding is retired after 3 consecutive note_absent calls, making the local ticket unbound, after which outbound_differ creates a fresh Jira issue, causing unwanted resurrection on eventual consistency

The operator ruling requires that once a Jira issue is deleted it must not be resurrected, necessitating a tombstone guard on the unbound-create arm to suppress creation of local tickets whose bindings were retired on confirmed 404s

Deletion discrimination is already implemented live twice (outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py bounded GET), verified on real DC, so the (inbound, probe) arm is architecturally redundant and must be deleted
A new BindingStore.unretire(jira_key) API and suppression message must exist to make the tombstone reversible and observable rather than forcing manual state file editing
